explanation: This fires only at D1, after the agent chose a2, reached S2 by the common route and was rewarded on at least the last two trials in a row: it scores about 10 around trials 70-80, about 5 around trials 55-60 and 85-90, and 0 before trial ~50. It stays 0 at every GO and D2 step, after a1 choices, after only one reward in the streak, and after any rare transition; on the first D1 after the streak ends with no reward it falls to about 2, then to 0.
